evidence_summaries: I built ANMA because I noticed that cheaper models would often ignore architecture rules. So I did several benchmarks using "Claude Haiku 4.5" with and without ANMA; without ANMA it ignored the "rules" 13 out of 19 runs, with ANMA, 0 out of 20 runs. What is "ANMA"? YAML contracts with CLAUDE.md, hooks, and CI checks What about stronger/expensive models? They followed the architecture rules. The question is, would cheaper models with stronger rules be the best affordable default for coding? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48623765 Points: 2 # Comments: 2
